zh: 新增「單一真實產品分析」：只有一份保單／理財／債券利益表時，不再要求湊第二份產品。貼入逐年利益表即可直接計算真實 IRR、累計投入、總回報、回本、純現金回本、翻倍與指定年期可取價值，收益圖會同時畫出產品累計價值與累計投入本金。
智能輸入框支援「整份資料直接貼入」：例如同一句寫明「本金100萬、重點看第5年」，再附上逐年表，系統會自動抽取本金、指定年期與表格本身；資料齊全時可零追問直接生成分析，不需要把同一張表再貼第二次。
多產品比較由兩產品擴充到 3–4 份真實利益表同場分析。結果同時提供 IRR 排名、指定年期可取價值排名、每份產品回本／翻倍節點，以及所有產品兩兩之間的反超時間，並特別提示「期末金額最高」與「IRR最高」可能不是同一產品。
收益曲線底層升級為多序列，可在同一張圖展示最多四份產品；第三、第四條曲線、圖例及節點同步支援結果頁、核心分享海報和分析書，不再只能用 A/B 兩條線。
自然語言分流進一步細分「一份／兩份／三份／四份利益表」：一份走單產品體檢、兩份走精確比較、三至四份走多產品排名；「第20年排名／第10年差額」等指定年份亦會直接帶入，不再默認使用表格最後一年。
Android / iOS 的保單 OCR 入口已擴展到單產品、產品 C 及產品 D 的逐年表輸入；OCR 後仍保留人工核對步驟，避免誤識別被直接當成財務結論。
對抗性與角色測試擴充至 18 類常見使用者，包括單一保單體檢者、三產品同場比較者及四產品批量篩選者；新增多序列收益圖、自然語言整表直貼、3–4 產品排名與 390×844 手機流程回歸。完整 Flutter 回歸 103 項全部通過，相關新代碼靜態分析 0 issues，Web Release 構建成功。
en: Added Single Real-Product Analysis. One policy, wealth-management or bond schedule can now be analyzed on its own for real IRR, cumulative contributions, total return, total-value payback, cash-only payback, doubling and redeemable value at a chosen horizon. The chart compares product value with cumulative contributed capital.

The free-form Smart input can now accept an entire schedule directly. If the same input states the starting capital and focus year and includes the yearly rows, those values are reused automatically and the analysis can run with zero follow-up questions.

Expanded real-table comparison to 3–4 products side by side. Results include IRR ranking, end-value ranking, payback and doubling for each product, plus pairwise crossover timing across every selected product. The UI explicitly distinguishes highest end value from highest IRR.
Upgraded the growth-chart model from two fixed series to multi-series so up to four product curves, legends and milestones render consistently in the result view, core share poster and analysis book.

Natural-language routing now distinguishes one, two, three and four benefit tables and carries focus-year phrases such as “year 20 ranking” into the correct analysis instead of silently defaulting to the last table year.
Android/iOS policy OCR is now available for single-product input and Product C / D tables as well, while still requiring user review before calculation.

Expanded the persona matrix to 18 common user types and added regressions for direct whole-table paste, multi-series charts, 3–4 product ranking and 390×844 mobile flows. All 103 Flutter tests pass, targeted static analysis reports 0 issues, and the Web release build succeeds.
